items.notes: Different failure mode: too few replications, not a near-zero mean; no denominator or relative-error scaling discussion.
Separates input uncertainty from sampling error and denies assumed=measured; supports why convergence alone cannot support a decision, but states no decision criterion.
Limits what validation gates establish and denies pattern promotion; does not describe the reverse index or what a decision mention establishes.
Directly separates verification (implemented as specified) from decision validity (follows from model and constraints).
Statuses establish that repeated assumed inputs stay assumed and derived inputs inherit the weakest status; supports the answer without addressing confidence intervals.
Enumerates declared constraint classes and valid outcomes but never compares treatment of a failed hard constraint with a soft preference.
Common workload and per-success metrics (cost per 1000 successes) across 12/12/18-server candidates support comparability; the normalization principle is shown, not stated.
Provenance binds a run record to its model, scenario, inputs and engine and makes replay a new activity; does not state what happens on input change.
Generic v07 table on admission, queue and bulkhead purposes; no V12 engine behavior at the admission limit.
Worked sequence has the late completion find no in-service request and be ignored after timeout, so the server is not freed twice.
